purpose: Separate repository activity from publication. Cloudflare is the canonical production publication boundary for the canonical Hub; deployment remains explicitly authorized and fail-closed.
non_deploying_changes: ordinary source commits unless explicitly authorized for release
bypass_prohibition: No GitHub workflow, repository event, commit, branch push, pull request, note, document, or automation may invoke production deployment outside the canonical Cloudflare release workflow and release authorization contract.
truth_rule: CONNECTED != DEPLOYABLE; COMMITTED != RELEASED; VERIFIED != PRODUCTION_PROVEN; AUTHORIZED != SUCCESSFUL UNTIL DEPLOYMENT EVIDENCE EXISTS.

legacy_vercel.reason: Historical/connected infrastructure retained as history only; it is not the canonical Hub publication boundary for this execution frontier.
